title: Throughput budgeting playbook and fleet economics scenario library
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: deliver a reusable playbook and scenario library that helps PMs, SREs, and Fleet Owners pick committed capacity and autoscaling policies for Dedicated pools by trading off throughput guarantees, latency SLOs, and amortized cost. Outputs: (1) throughput budgeting model (capacity -> guaranteed TPS/reqs/min), (2) autoscale policy templates with headroom knobs and cooldowns, (3) utilization reporting that attributes amortized infra cost to customer throughput, and (4) a backtest runner to simulate historical workloads and compare cost/quality outcomes.
acceptance_criteria: Budget model produces expected throughput vs committed GPU count for at least 3 representative model families (Llama2-like, Mistral-like, small/medium encoder-only)
Three autoscale policy templates implemented in config schema + runtime: conservative (min headroom 30%), balanced (20%), aggressive (10%)
Utilization report shows amortized cost-per-1000-tokens and headroom percentage per tenant for last 30/90 days
Backtest runner can replay 30 days of production traces and output cost / SLA breach summary for each policy scenario
API endpoints for exporting recommended commit size and suggested autoscale policy (JSON) are available and documented
Design sign-off from PM (Marina Chen) and an SRE review with roll-forward/rollback checklist
implementation_plan: Phase 1: Design model and metric definitions (this ticket) — produce spec and knobs
Phase 2: Instrument runtime to export per-pool throughput and KV cache hit rates (ENG-864121)
Phase 3: Build budgeting service that maps capacity to guaranteed throughput and headroom curves
Phase 4: Autoscaler policy templates + runtime enforcement and safe-rollout
Phase 5: Reporting UI and export API for recommendations
Phase 6: Backtest engine and 30-day historical analysis; run tabletop with two pilot customers
Phase 7: Post-launch monitoring and iterate (2-week cadence for first month)
dashboards_and_reports: Per-pool economics dashboard: committed GPUs, avg utilization, amortized cost, 30/90 day trend
Policy comparison report: cost delta and SLA breaches across conservative/balanced/aggressive policies
Tenant-level utilization export (CSV/BigQuery) for finance and customer success
Backtest summary artifacts for each run with scenario tags and diffable outputs
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: inaccurate mapping of committed GPUs -> delivered throughput for newer quantized kernels. Mitigation: validate model with canary workloads and conservative default headroom.
Risk: autoscale oscillation around traffic spikes. Mitigation: introduce cooldown windows, hysteresis and a max-scale-per-minute cap.
Risk: customers misunderstand recommendation and undersubscribe, causing breaches. Mitigation: add clear confidence bands and recommended safety buffers in UI and API.
Risk: cost model divergence due to spot/commit pricing changes. Mitigation: surface assumptions and allow override of price inputs per-tenant
rollout_and_migration: Soft-launch: enable reporting-only mode for 2 weeks for 5 pilot Dedicated pools
Pilot customers: Partner X and internal e2e test team; collect feedback and iterate
Gradual enforcement: start with 'recommend-only' then opt-in autoscale application for selected pools
Full rollout: enable recommendations + one-click apply in console and API after 4 weeks of stable telemetry
